Frequently asked questions

  • Canva Pro is the perfect subscription for individuals who want to create professional content fast. With access to premium content, and AI-powered features, it's your all-in-one platform that’ll help you build your personal brand, boost creativity, and hit your goals effortlessly.

  • Canva Pro makes designing easy, fun, and stress-free. Whether you're building a passion project or starting a new side hustle, it helps you achieve your goals with ease.

    With Canva Pro, you will get access to premium content, design tools, and AI-powered features that will save you time and make your work shine.

    From brainstorming and content creation to printing your final masterpiece, Canva Pro's all-in-one solution offers everything you need to create professional and engaging content - fast.

  • Yes, Canva is always free for every individual. With Canva Free, you can create, design, and explore a library of free templates and content to bring your ideas to life. For access to premium features like Magic Resize and Brand Kit, you can upgrade to Canva Pro to take your designs to the next level.

  • Canva Free is perfect for exploring design basics, offering a library of free templates and content to help you get started. Canva Pro unlocks all the powerful premium features you need to create professional-quality designs.

    This includes Background Remover, 40+ AI-powered tools, access to world-class premium content library – including templates, images, videos, graphics, audio tracks, fonts and more.

    Canva Pro is perfect for creators looking to save time, and design like a pro. AI allowance during trial is the same as Canva Free. Access the full allowance (10x more) when you start your paid plan.

  • Canva Pro is the ideal plan for individuals who want to create professional designs with ease. While Canva Pro allows you to share projects and collaborate on designs, it's primarily designed for solo creators looking to save time and achieve polished results.

    If you need advanced team collaboration features, such as shared workspaces and approval workflows, Canva Business⁠(opens in a new tab or window) might be better for you.

  • Canva Pro is the perfect plan for content creators who want premium editing tools, AI features, and templates to create faster and design like a pro.

    Canva Business is built for individuals and growing teams. It includes everything in Canva Pro, plus 20x more AI usage than the Free plan, advanced brand controls, Flourish Presenter for interactive data visualisation, a shared workspace for seamless collaboration and more. Discover how Canva Business can help your business grow, all in one place.

  • Primary and secondary school students can use Canva Education⁠(opens in a new tab or window), our free offering designed for classrooms and educators. Canva Education is currently unavailable for college and university students, but you can still access Canva Free or upgrade to Canva Pro to unlock premium features.

  • Our Canva Free and Canva Pro Content licences cover all of the content we offer - from photos, icons and illustrations, to videos, audio, fonts, and templates. Visit our Help Center page⁠(opens in a new tab or window) to learn about Content licences and how to use Canva for commercial purposes.
